title: pizza stand
text: pizza stand. These work... however, I wish the tops were tubed with some silicone or like so that the pizza pans - metal or paper would not slip and slide around.  and then some silicone or rubber feet on the bottom for the same reason, less slipping and sliding on the table.  Maybe I should invent that.  Haha... You get two.  They are polished metal - and wipe clean.  They stand about 6" off the table (eye balling it)  The really big family size pizzas (take and bake) don't really fit well and dip in. But a regular "large" works.  And of course a metal pan will not dip in the middle or edges - but again, slips off the metal stand.  :)  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review is helpful to you!

description: Serve pizzas like a professional with American Metalcraft’s Universal Pizza Stand! Made from high-quality steel for years of everyday use, this single-shelf stand will help save tablespace while giving diners an authentic pizzeria experience. Perfect for any home or restaurant, our Universal Pizza Stand offers a sleek, simple look that goes with any décor while keeping hot pizza pans sturdy, elevated, and safe. Each order contains one square pizza stand measuring 12” Sq. x 7” H. With 70 years of service, American Metalcraft is a leader in the foodservice industry for trend-focused and unique products.
